# v0.3.1 — repo restructure, security overrides, CI hardening

Infrastructure release: no changes to the five tools, their schemas, or the
resource URIs. Everything here is about how the project is laid out, secured,
and shipped.

## Repo restructure

- The package now lives at the **repository root** (previously `freebuff-mcp/`),
  so `package.json`, `src/`, and `test/` are top-level and CI paths no longer
  need a subdirectory prefix
- Workflows, `dependabot.yml`, and the README were updated to match; the
  `v0.3.0` tag and release were preserved through the history rewrite

## Security

- **All 13 open Dependabot alerts cleared.** They were runtime-scope transitive
  dependencies of `@codebuff/sdk@0.10.7` (the latest release, so there was no
  upgrade path) and are now pinned with npm `overrides`:
  - `undici` 5.29.0 → **6.28.1** — 5.29.0 is the end of the 5.x line, so
    patching required the major hop; 6.28.1 clears every advisory threshold
  - `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` 3.0.18 → **3.0.37** — same-major, and 3.0.37 was
    already resolved elsewhere in the tree, so this also dedupes
- Verified live rather than by CI alone: the server reports
  `backend reachable: yes` and completes a full agent network round-trip on
  undici 6, with typecheck, build and the protocol smoke suite green

## CI hardening

- **Runtime audit gate**: CI runs `npm run audit:runtime` and fails the build on
  any runtime-scope advisory. It parses npm audit's JSON report instead of
  trusting the exit code, which was observed exiting 0 on a tree containing a
  high-severity finding. Threshold is tunable via `AUDIT_MIN_SEVERITY`
- **Dependabot auto-merge**: minor and patch npm PRs get auto-merge enabled once
  the required checks pass; major npm bumps and `github-actions` updates stay
  manual. Verified end-to-end against a real grouped bump PR
- **Branch protection** on `main` requires both CI matrix checks before merging
- Actions bumped: `actions/checkout` and `actions/setup-node` to v7,
  `dependabot/fetch-metadata` to v3

## Dependency updates

| Package                    | From     | To                          |
| -------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------- |
| `zod`                      | 3.25.76  | **4.6.2**                   |
| `typescript`               | 5.9.3    | **7.0.2**                   |
| `@types/node`              | 22.20.2  | **26.5.1**                  |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`| 1.19.1   | **1.30.0** (via lockfile)   |

`zod` 4 is supported by `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` (`^3.25 || ^4.0`) and is
already what `@codebuff/sdk` uses, so the bump unifies the tree on one zod
rather than shipping two copies.

## Publishing

- The publish workflow is **OIDC-ready** (npm trusted publishing: Node 24, npm
  ≥ 11.5.1), so a long-lived `NPM_TOKEN` is no longer required once a trusted
  publisher is configured for the repository
- Added `workflow_dispatch`: a stalled publish can be retried against its
  release tag instead of recreating the release

## Compatibility

- No tool, option, or resource changes — drop-in upgrade
- Node.js >= 18 unchanged (CI covers 20 and 22)
